title: Saturday chair and stage setup
description: Move chairs, set the stage, and run a quick sound check the evening before Sunday.

title: Sunday morning welcome team
description: Greet people at the door, hand out bulletins, and help visitors find a seat before the 9am service.

title: Kids church helpers
description: Help run the lesson and games for the 5-8 year olds during the second service.

title: Coffee and pastries after service
description: Brew coffee, set out cups and pastries, and clean up once the hall empties.

title: Food bank packing night
description: Sort donations and pack boxes for families in the neighbourhood. Wear comfortable shoes.

title: Worship band rehearsal
description: Run through Sunday's set list. Singers and instrumentalists both welcome.

title: Building clean-up morning
description: Deep clean the hall, wipe down the chairs, and tidy the storage room.

title: Nursery care team
description: Look after infants and toddlers during the 9am and 11am services.

title: Community soup kitchen
description: Prepare and serve a hot meal for the weekly community lunch downtown.

title: Sunday lunch clean-up crew
description: Wash dishes, wipe tables, and reset the kitchen after the fellowship lunch.
